answer: Here is one mechanism that works: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because plume only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, beacon is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any mirror approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
